title: Replace newsletter alert lists; keep old links working
description:
**Milestone:** M3, public email and new stories

**Goal.** Settled: new-story replaces alert lists; subscribers move without re-confirming. Roundups stay in the plugin until the digest epic.

**Build.**
Plugin action to export a site's alert-list rows and suppressions for Caducus kanbus-25c166. Unsubscribe and preferences routes forward alert-list changes, since manage tokens in sent mail never expire. `announce_published` stops raising alert issues for a site once it is moved, per site. Panel stops listing alert issues there. `docs/newsletter.md` updated. Sites with alert lists today: Shipped and Distinctive.

**Acceptance.**
Migrated site: one message per publish, not two; an old link unsubscribes.

**Depends on:** PPY-38be08
**Related:** kanbus-25c166
